versions.name: Reference: the measured human landing on Jr's poses
Heavy: long deep landings, big antics, a lamp with real weight in the head
Snappy: Jr's own quick chain, no pause between hops, straight to the name
Follow through: head carries far past the base, drags and whips on every move
Snappy, five jumps: the film's whole hop chain, each hop a different size, ends standing tall over the base
Crouch up: five jumps refit to the new rest spot, ends crouched under the key looking up at it
Snap: five jumps on clean arcs, deep squash, long stretch, settles after every landing
One, hold, two, hold, one: last hop onto the mark, then the look and light
One, hold, two onto the mark, light straight away
Like i, same length: bigger poses, holds on every extreme incl. the air, steady x in the air
Published lamp, same poses and jumps, snappier timing
